claude.country: Not reported (synthetic data based on UK/Finnish/US parameters)
models_evaluated: discrete-time survival ensemble with isotonic calibration

links.outcome: Calibration-in-the-large versus bin-level ECE and AUC for diabetes risk model
links.effect: AUC 0.844 and ECE 0.006, yet predicted 8.4% vs observed 5.6% (O:E 0.66, 95% CI 0.65-0.67); ECE alone concealed 50% overprediction.
links.quote: Despite achieving excellent discrimination (AUC = 0.844, 95% CI: 0.840-0.848) and low bin-level calibration error (ECE = 0.006), the framework systematically overpredicted risk by 50%: mean predicted probability was 8.4% versus observed rate of 5.6% (observed-to-expected ratio = 0.66, 95% CI: 0.65-0.67).

links.outcome: Comparison of new framework against QDiabetes-2018 on same synthetic cohort
links.effect: QDiabetes-2018 had comparable AUC (0.831 vs 0.844) with better calibration (O:E 0.89 vs 0.66).
links.quote: QDiabetes-2018 achieved comparable discrimination (AUC = 0.831) with better calibration (O:E = 0.89).
